## Public-safe analytical walkthrough

This document shows a generic restricted-data workflow. It does not access, display, or describe the original project.

### 1. Audit the analysis cohort

```{r cohort, eval=FALSE}
source("R/01_cohort_audit.R")
analytic_cohort |>
  dplyr::count(screening_setting)
```

### 2. Construct outcomes and uncertainty intervals

```{r outcomes, eval=FALSE}
source("R/02_screening_outcomes.R")
exact_prevalence(screening_outcomes, "exam_positive")
```

### 3. Estimate adjusted associations

```{r model, eval=FALSE}
source("R/03_regression_models.R")
odds_ratios |>
  dplyr::filter(term != "(Intercept)")
```

Inputs and outputs remain in authorized private locations.
